title: Will it help the reach?
instruction: The recommender watches what viewers do with a video. Which behaviour sends the video on, and which holds it back?

items.text: People watch the video to the end
items.why: Watch time is the strongest signal.

items.text: Most people skip it after two seconds
items.why: Skipping says: this doesn’t hold attention.

items.text: People send it to their friends
A discussion takes off in the comments under the video
items.why: Comments keep people at the video longer, even when they are arguing.

debrief: The recommender counts mostly on watch time and on what viewers do afterwards. Skipping is a clear signal to it that the video doesn’t hold attention.
